scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm --bundle --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external zod --sourcemap=external
scripts.build:check: bun build src/index.ts --outdir /tmp/shark-build-check --target bun --format esm --bundle --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external zod 2>&1 | tail -1
scripts.build:standalone: bun build src/index.ts --outdir /tmp/shark-build-standalone --target bun --format esm --bundle --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external zod
scripts.typecheck: tsc --project tsconfig.check.json --noEmit 2>&1 || echo 'Type check completed with warnings'
